acceptance_criteria.description: The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset
acceptance_criteria.when: The reset link is sent to the user's email
acceptance_criteria.then: The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must be between 8 and 64 characters.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link
acceptance_criteria.then: The new password must be between 8 and 64 characters.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must contain at least 1 digit.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link
acceptance_criteria.then: The new password must contain at least 1 digit.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can request at most 3 reset emails per hour.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link
acceptance_criteria.then: A user can request at most 3 reset emails per hour.

acceptance_criteria.description: The new password must not equal the current password.
acceptance_criteria.given: A user requests a password reset
acceptance_criteria.when: The user clicks the reset link
acceptance_criteria.then: The new password must not equal the current password.
